question: How did the sage direct a terrible curse at the great goddess?
premises: The sage is the agent of cursing.
The great goddess is the target.
The curse is delivered terribly from the water-pot.
inference: The sage terribly cursed the great goddess using water from his water-pot.
uncertainties: dāruṇaṃ may qualify the curse or the manner; taken adverbially here.
plain_english: The sage terribly cursed the great goddess from his water-pot.
